name: Shards of Heaven
body:
School evocation [good]; Level cleric/oracle 7, white necromancer 7

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 10 min./level, see text

DESCRIPTION

You call upon the raw energy of the heavens and create 1 floating shard of heavenly energy per 2 caster levels.

Each shard glows golden light with the strength of a candle.

As a swift action, you may make a ranged touch attack with one of your shards. On a hit, the shard deals 1d6 damage per 3 caster levels and the shard is expended. If the target is evil-aligned, the damage increases to 1d8s, if the target is an undead or evil outsider, the damage increases to 1d12.

If the duration expires or all of the shards have been expended, the spell ends.
